zh: 第七夜，三更。蓮心小築的池水，又冒了一次泡。
洛先生。龜息三天，你比我想的，撐得還久。
多謝月姑娘，在池底等了三天。
鏡王拆穿了，劍譜換了。明天，殷九霄就會翻開那本書。
那明天，無塵就去看他翻書。
第八夜。千面鏡王，帶著地機卷，走進了龍淵閣。
閣主。地機卷，帝君的禮物。
帝君的禮物……鏡王，九霄現在很想知道，收下這份禮，要付多少代價。
儒門之印、太虛之令、佛門之印。三道封印，今夜，一起打開。
不可能……燕飛霜親手交給你的……
洛無塵！你……你不是死了嗎？！
閣主親眼看見無塵落水，可閣主沒有看見，無塵從水裡出來。
中了夜無極的九掌，沒有人活得下來！
所以，無塵在中掌之前，就已經死了。
鏡湖的龜息之法。心跳停了，血也冷了，三天之內，跟死人一模一樣。是我教他的。
至於那一池紅蓮——是無塵三個月前，親手種下的硃砂。夜裡一受震動，就會化開。
……三個月前？你三個月前，就算到了今天？
魏兄，無塵說過，我算不到的，是人心。可是殷閣主的心，太好算了。
還有我！還有我！閣主桌上的那本天劍譜，是我換的！真的那本，在這裡！
就是你送鏡王出門的那一夜！洛先生說，閣主送客的時候，最不會回頭看自己的桌子！
一百兩！這是我這輩子，賺得最值的一百兩！
……洛先生，你從頭到尾，都在騙我們？
騙你們，是因為只有你們真的傷心，殷閣主才會真的相信。燕姑娘，對不起。
殷閣主。無塵說過，一個人，只有在他以為贏了的時候，才會把真心拿出來。
閣主拆開三道封印、翻開天機策的那一刻，三教，都看見了。
殷兄。你那壺酒，原來是這個味道。
阿彌陀佛。殷施主，回頭吧。
天下這盤棋，憑什麼要讓三教共議？憑什麼要讓一個和尚、一個酒鬼、一個閒雲野鶴，來決定天下？
九霄讀了三十年聖賢書，書裡寫的，全是一個人，就能讓天下太平！
書裡寫的那個人，不是閣主。
洛無塵，這一個，分我一半！
天機策合一的時候，到了。
幽冥帝君。你等的，原來是這一刻。
洛無塵，你很聰明。你騙過了殷九霄，騙過了鏡王，可你騙不過天機——
兩卷天機策，此刻，就在這一間屋子裡。
凌雲霄。這一次，在帝君面前，本尊陪你玩。
殷九霄。你這顆棋，用完了。
天機合一，人間與幽冥之間的門，就會打開。想要回去，就到幽冥來。
我沒事……劍譜，被他們搶走了。
他要的，從來不是天機策。他要的，是兩卷合一的那一刻，那股能打開門的力量。
不見了！剛才還趴在那裡，一眨眼，就不見了！
讓他走吧。一顆被丟掉的棋，比誰都清楚，下棋的人在哪裡。
洛無塵，你又算計了所有人一次。
這一次去幽冥，我們一起打。不演戲，不算計。
無塵叫你不要回頭，你還是回頭了。所以無塵知道，你是真的朋友。
幽冥之門，不是一人一劍，能夠關上的。
那就三教一起去。和尚，酒鬼，再加上一個閒雲野鶴。
還有鏡湖。鏡王欠我的，我要親手討回來。
幽冥？哈哈哈！這麼好看的戲，本郎君，怎麼能不去？
本郎君，永遠站在，最好看的那一邊。
天機逆轉，局中有局；可最後的一局，要在沒有日月的地方下。
en: The seventh night, in the third watch. The water of the Lotus Heart Retreat bubbled once again.
Master Luo. Three days of tortoise breath — you held out longer than I thought you would.
Thank you, Miss Yue, for waiting three days at the bottom of the pond.
The Mirror King is unmasked; the manual has been swapped. Tomorrow Yin Jiuxiao will open the book.
Then tomorrow, Wuchen will go and watch him read.
Qian Bu’er... is he all right?
The eighth night. The Mirror King walked into the Dragon Abyss Pavilion with the Earthly Scroll.
Pavilion Master. The Earthly Scroll — a gift from the Emperor.
A gift from the Emperor... Mirror King, I should very much like to know what price comes with it.
Open it, and the Pavilion Master will know.
The Confucian seal, the Void token, the Buddhist seal. Tonight, all three come open together.
The Heavenly Sword Manual. The Earthly Scroll. The Celestial Stratagem...
The Heavenly Sword Manual is blank paper?!
Impossible... Yan Feishuang gave it to you with her own hands...
Pavilion Master — is the Stratagem a good read?
The lotus fell into the pond and dreamed three days;
it opens again, smiling at the spring wind as before.
Luo Wuchen! You... aren’t you dead?!
The Pavilion Master saw Wuchen go into the water. He did not see Wuchen come out of it.
No one survives the Nine Palms of Ye Wuji!
Which is why Wuchen was already dead before the palm struck him.
The tortoise breath of the Mirror Lake. The heart stops, the blood goes cold, and for three days you are no different from a dead man. I taught it to him.
As for that pond of red lotus — Wuchen planted the cinnabar himself, three months ago. Shaken in the night, it dissolves.
...Three months ago? Three months ago you already foresaw today?
Brother Wei, Wuchen told you: what I cannot foresee is men’s hearts. But the Pavilion Master’s heart was all too easy to reckon.
And me! And me! The manual on the Pavilion Master’s desk — I swapped it! The real one is here!
The night you saw the Mirror King out! Master Luo said that when the Pavilion Master sees a guest out, he never looks back at his desk!
A hundred taels! The best hundred taels I ever earned!
Miss Yan — back to its rightful owner.
...Master Luo — you were deceiving us all from beginning to end?
I deceived you because only if you truly grieved would the Pavilion Master truly believe. Miss Yan — forgive me.
Pavilion Master. Wuchen once said that a man shows his true heart only when he believes he has won.
The moment you broke the three seals and opened the Stratagem, all three Teachings saw it.
Brother Yin. So that is what your wine tasted of.
Turn back? ...Ha. Ha ha ha ha!
Why should the game of the world be decided by three Teachings together? Why should a monk, a drunkard and an idle crane decide all under heaven?
I have read the books of the sages for thirty years, and every page says: one man alone can bring peace to all under heaven!
The man in those books is not the Pavilion Master.
Then I shall rewrite them with my own hand!
Lotus Sword Light: Three Thousand Worlds!
Luo Wuchen — half of this one is mine!
Lotus Sword Light: Three Thousand Worlds!
The Heavenly Sword Manual — give it to me!
Mirror Light of Ten Thousand Forms!
In the Netherworld there is no sun, no moon;
my throne holds down heaven and earth.
The hour when the Stratagem is made whole has come.
The Netherworld Emperor. So this is the moment you were waiting for.
Luo Wuchen, you are very clever. You fooled Yin Jiuxiao, you fooled the Mirror King — but you cannot fool heaven’s design —
both halves of the Stratagem are, at this moment, in this one room.
Ling Yunxiao. This time, before my Emperor, I’ll play with you.
And the Earthly Scroll is here.
Yin Jiuxiao. You are a piece that has been used up.
The Nine Hells Fall from Heaven!
When the Stratagem is whole, the gate between the world of men and the Netherworld will open. If you want it back — come to the Netherworld.
I’m all right... but they took the manual.
It was never the Stratagem he wanted. He wanted the power of the moment the two halves become one — the power that opens the gate.
the world of men becomes a second Netherworld.
Gone! He was lying right there a moment ago — and in a blink, he’s gone!
Let him go. A piece that has been thrown away knows better than anyone where the player sits.
Luo Wuchen, you’ve schemed against every one of us again.
...Next time, before you scheme against me — tell me first.
If I told you, it would not be scheming.
This time, in the Netherworld, we fight together. No acting. No scheming.
Gu Hong. That night, you looked back.
Wuchen told you not to look back, and still you did. That is how Wuchen knows you are a true friend.
The gate of the Netherworld cannot be closed by one man and one sword.
Then the three Teachings go together. A monk, a drunkard — and an idle crane.
And the Mirror Lake. What the Mirror King owes me, I will take back with my own hands.
The Netherworld? Ha ha ha! A show this fine — how could I possibly miss it?
And on which side will the Gentleman stand?
I always stand on whichever side is the best to watch.
The Stratagem has turned, a game within a game; but the last game must be played where there is no sun and no moon.
Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Lotus — the final episode.
